archetype: The High-Clarity Linear-Stripe Hybrid (Light Mode Architecture)

theme.description: Ultra-refined light theme inspired by Stripe's warm crisp white canvas (#FAFAFA / #F8F9FA) paired with Linear's precision engineering hierarchy, restrained borders, and Notion's tactile workspace calm. Absolutely no loud gradients, generic AI purple glows, or vibrating colors.

typography.font_family_headings: Plus Jakarta Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
typography.font_family_body: Plus Jakarta Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, SF Mono, Menlo, monospace

hierarchy.h1: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-tight
hierarchy.overline: text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-[0.08em] uppercase text-slate-400 font-mono
hierarchy.metric_giant: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900 font-mono

rules: Financial, credit figures, and platform tokens must use font-mono tabular numbers (font-mono tracking-tight)
Strict prohibition against overusing heavy black weights: use font-medium (500) and font-semibold (600) for disciplined restraint

shell_structure.main_container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8

app_shell.sidebar: Clean Notion/Linear style sidebar with module grouping, clean active indicator (bg-slate-100 text-indigo-600 font-medium with 3px left indicator or subtle rounded pill), org/individual mode pill, and user profile switcher at bottom.
app_shell.topbar: Sticky header with backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 border-b border-[#E4E7EC], active route title + breadcrumb, 'View as role' badge/switcher, simulated data indicator, notifications bell, and quick user dropdown.
app_shell.mobile_drawer: Sheet drawer sliding from left on viewports < 768px with touch backdrop and easy close.

demo_logins.placement: Prominent, frictionless one-click card on Login page with 4 distinct tiles (Org Admin, Team Manager, Staff Member / Employee, Individual Freelancer/Creator), each explaining their unique role permissions.
demo_logins.role_switcher: Floating or topbar segmented control / dropdown for instant role toggling during demonstrations.

simulated_badge.spec: Refined pill badge `px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border border-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5`, includes a subtle pulse or static slate dot and tooltip 'All telemetry in Phase 1 is synthetically modeled to simulate realistic team consumption'.

coming_soon_module_state.spec: Polished empty-state container with module preview graphic, concise architectural roadmap summary for Phase 2/3, badge 'Phase 2 Planned', and a 'Notify me when ready' or 'Learn roadmap' interactive button.

access_denied_state.spec: Clean Stripe-styled permission shield icon, explicit explanation of required tier/role (e.g., 'Requires Organisation Admin or Manager privileges'), and an instant 'Switch to Org Admin demo account' shortcut.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use dark gradients or pitch black cards. Keep background warm white (#FBFBFC) with pure white (#FFFFFF) cards and subtle 1px slate-200 borders.

Ensure every page and interactive button has explicit `data-testid` attributes (e.g. data-testid='demo-login-admin-button', data-testid='role-switcher-dropdown', data-testid='range-filter-30d', data-testid='simulated-data-badge').

On the login page, provide both standard JWT email/password login and 4 fast 1-click Demo buttons: 'Org Admin (Alex Vance)', 'Manager (Sarah Chen)', 'Employee (David Miller)', and 'Individual (Elena Rostova)'.
Support Google OAuth flow + first-time Mode Picker ('Individual' vs 'Organisation') modal/route.
Implement the 'View as role' switcher in the global Topbar with clear feedback toast and state update so evaluators can switch roles effortlessly without re-logging.
Use Recharts for AI Usage with smooth stacked areas, provider donuts, and high-clarity tooltips with provider colors.
Provide responsive drawer navigation for screens below 768px using Shadcn Sheet or mobile overlay.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid the generic AI look with high-saturation neon blues or purples. Use muted Indigo #4F46E5 with soft slate neutrals.
Do not center-align the app container. Align content left with clean breathing room and 24-32px gutters.
Use Sonner for toast notifications when switching roles, signing in, or filtering datasets.
Maintain high APCA text contrast: slate-900 on white for headings, slate-600 for body, slate-500 for captions.
Every module must show either real live views (Overview & AI Usage) or the polished Phase 2 Roadmap state without breaking shell navigation.
